name: Anthropic
what: An AI company that builds the Claude models and does a lot of public safety research, like interpretability and alignment stress tests.

name: OpenAI (safety work)
what: The company behind ChatGPT. Its safety teams work on preparedness, red teaming and alignment, and several safety leaders have left publicly.

name: Google DeepMind (AGI safety)
what: Google's AI lab. Its AGI safety teams study misuse and misalignment, interpretability and its Frontier Safety Framework.

name: Redwood Research
what: A research group that started the field of AI control: staying safe even if a powerful AI is secretly trying to cause harm.

name: METR (Model Evaluation and Threat Research)
what: Tests frontier AI models for dangerous abilities, like doing long tasks alone, and tracks how fast that ability grows.

name: Apollo Research
what: Tests whether AI models can scheme, meaning hide their real goals or deceive the people checking them.

name: Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI)
what: One of the oldest AI risk groups. It now works mainly on public communication and policy to stop the race to superintelligence.

name: Alignment Research Center (ARC)
what: Works on theory for explaining why neural networks behave the way they do, so we can catch bad behavior before it happens.

name: UK AI Security Institute
what: The UK government's team that tests frontier AI models for serious risks and funds safety research. It was the first institute of its kind.

name: US Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI)
what: The US government center inside NIST that tests and measures AI systems. It began as the US AI Safety Institute and was renamed in 2025.

name: Center for AI Safety (CAIS)
what: Does safety research, runs compute for researchers, and organized the 2023 Statement on AI Risk.

name: Future of Life Institute (FLI)
what: Works to steer powerful technology away from large scale risks. It organized the 2023 pause letter and the 2025 Statement on Superintelligence.

name: Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI)
what: Researches how governments and companies should govern advanced AI, and trains new policy researchers.

name: Epoch AI
what: Collects data on AI progress, like how much compute and data models use, and makes clear charts about trends.

name: AI Futures Project
what: Writes detailed forecasts and scenarios about advanced AI. Best known for the AI 2027 scenario.

name: FAR.AI
what: Runs research on robustness and alignment and hosts events that connect safety researchers.

name: Palisade Research
what: Studies what today's AI agents can do, such as resisting shutdown or hacking, to show the risk of losing control.

name: Conjecture
what: A London AI safety company focused on building AI that stays bounded and controllable.

name: Center for Human-Compatible AI (CHAI)
what: A Berkeley research center working on AI that is provably beneficial and stays uncertain about what humans want.

name: BlueDot Impact
what: Runs free online courses on AI safety, AI governance and biosecurity, and helps graduates start careers in the field.

name: MATS (ML Alignment and Theory Scholars)
what: A mentorship program that pairs new researchers with senior AI safety mentors for focused research projects.

name: Constellation
what: A shared research space in Berkeley that hosts AI safety researchers and runs fellowship programs.

name: LawZero
what: A nonprofit started by Yoshua Bengio to build safe-by-design AI that puts safety ahead of commercial pressure.

name: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI)
what: A lab that says it works only on building safe superintelligence, with no other products.

name: ControlAI
what: Campaigns for an international ban on developing superintelligence and briefs lawmakers about extinction risk.

name: Forethought
what: Researches how society can get ready for an intelligence explosion, including risks like AI-enabled coups.

name: AI Impacts
what: Runs the largest surveys of AI researchers about when AI will get very capable and what the risks are.

name: Centre for the Study of Existential Risk (CSER)
what: A Cambridge University center that studies risks that could threaten humanity, including AI.

name: Center for Humane Technology
what: Works to make technology serve people, and warns about racing to deploy AI without safeguards.

name: Center for Security and Emerging Technology (CSET)
what: A Georgetown University think tank that studies how AI and other new technologies affect security.

name: Truthful AI
what: A Berkeley research group studying honesty, deception and surprising emergent behavior in language models.

name: ARENA (Alignment Research Engineer Accelerator)
what: A hands-on program that teaches the machine learning engineering skills needed for alignment research.

name: 80,000 Hours
what: Gives free career advice for people who want to work on the world's most pressing problems, with AI safety as a top priority.

name: PauseAI
what: A volunteer movement that campaigns for a global pause on building more powerful AI until it can be made safe.

name: IndiaAI Safety Institute
what: India's AI safety institute under the IndiaAI Mission. It uses a hub and spoke model with universities, startups and industry to test AI for risks in India's languages and social context.

name: Cooperative AI Foundation
what: Funds research on how AI systems can cooperate well with each other and with humans.

name: SaferAI
what: Rates and compares how well AI companies manage risk, and works on risk management standards.

name: Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy)
what: One of the largest funders of AI safety and governance work in the world.

name: European AI Office
what: The European Commission's office for AI. It oversees general-purpose AI models under the EU AI Act.

name: Canadian AI Safety Institute
what: Canada's national AI safety institute, launched in November 2024. Its research program is run with CIFAR.
url_status: blocked from our fetcher; listed from the launch press release

name: Japan AI Safety Institute (J-AISI)
what: Japan's AI safety institute, set up in February 2024 inside the Information-technology Promotion Agency. It works on safety evaluation methods, red teaming and standards.

name: Korea AI Safety Institute
what: South Korea's AI safety institute, opened in November 2024 under ETRI. It evaluates AI risks and works with other safety institutes.

name: Digital Trust Centre (Singapore AI Safety Institute)
what: The Digital Trust Centre at NTU Singapore, designated as Singapore's AI Safety Institute.

name: INESIA (France)
what: France's national institute for AI evaluation and security, created in January 2025. It links ANSSI, Inria, LNE and PEReN under the SGDSN and the DGE.

name: Australian AI Safety Institute
what: Australia's AI safety institute, announced in November 2025 inside the Department of Industry, Science and Resources. It analyses emerging AI capabilities, risks and harms.
url_status: blocked from our fetcher; listed from the department page

name: Concordia AI
what: A Beijing-based social enterprise on AI safety and governance. It does research, convenings, consulting and frontier risk monitoring.

name: Shanghai AI Laboratory
what: A major Chinese AI research lab. It builds the InternLM models and runs safety and open evaluation platforms.

name: Institute for AI International Governance, Tsinghua University
what: Tsinghua University's institute for international AI governance, led by Xue Lan.

name: Mila - Quebec AI Institute
what: A large deep learning research institute in Montreal founded by Yoshua Bengio.

name: Vector Institute
what: A Toronto AI research institute that links universities and industry.

name: Oxford Martin AI Governance Initiative
what: An Oxford University centre for frontier, international and technical AI governance.

name: Leverhulme Centre for the Future of Intelligence
what: A Cambridge University centre that studies the future of AI, including its risks, ethics and governance.

name: ETH AI Center
what: ETH Zurich's hub for AI research across departments.

name: Tubingen AI Center and ELLIS Institute Tubingen
what: A European AI research hub in Tubingen, linked with the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and the ELLIS Institute.

name: Goodfire
what: An AI interpretability research lab and public benefit corporation. It builds tools to understand, monitor and align AI models.

name: Transluce
what: An independent nonprofit lab for public oversight of AI. It builds open tools to understand AI systems.

name: EleutherAI
what: A nonprofit research group that builds open models, datasets and evaluation tools, with work on open-weight safety.

name: Simplex
what: An AI safety research group building a theory of how neural networks organize their internal representations. It hires in the Bay Area and London.

name: Timaeus (now Resolution)
what: An AI safety research group that uses singular learning theory to study how training data shapes AI behavior. It now goes by Resolution.

name: Apart Research
what: A nonprofit AI safety organization that runs research sprints and fellowships, with a research focus on harmful manipulation by AI.

name: CeSIA (French Center for AI Safety)
what: An independent French think tank on preventing major AI risks. It runs the Global Call for AI Red Lines and the AI Safety Atlas.

name: ERA Fellowship
what: A Cambridge research fellowship on risks from AI.

name: London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA)
what: An AI safety centre and ecosystem in London that hosts research organizations and individuals.

name: Centre for Long-Term Resilience
what: An independent UK think tank on resilience to extreme risks, including AI and biosecurity.

name: Meridian Cambridge
what: A Cambridge research hub and launch platform for AI safety research programmes.

name: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS)
what: A nonpartisan think tank that writes policy research on risks from powerful AI.

name: The Future Society
what: An independent nonprofit based in the US and Europe that works to align AI through better governance.

name: Frontier Model Forum
what: An industry body of frontier AI companies that shares safety and security practice, including on AI and bio, cyber and nuclear risks.

name: Partnership on AI
what: A nonprofit coalition of companies, academics and civil society on responsible AI, including AI safety.

name: International AI Safety Report
what: A yearly report on the risks of general-purpose AI, chaired by Yoshua Bengio and written by experts from many countries.

name: ILINA Program
what: An African-led organization that works on AI safety through research, policy work and talent development.

name: Global Center on AI Governance
what: An African-led center on AI policy and governance that works to reduce global inequalities made worse by AI. It runs the African Observatory.

name: Centre for Responsible AI (CeRAI), IIT Madras
what: IIT Madras's Centre for Responsible AI, which works on responsible and safe AI research and AI governance.

name: Digital Futures Lab
what: An independent research studio in India on technology and society in the Majority World, working toward safe digital futures.

name: AI Safety Asia
what: A network that works to give Asian countries a stronger voice in steering frontier AI.

name: Safe AI Forum
what: A nonprofit that drives global coordination to reduce extreme AI risks. It runs the International Dialogues on AI Safety (IDAIS).

name: Eleos AI Research
what: A nonprofit that studies the possible wellbeing and moral status of AI systems.

name: Mathematical AI Safety Institute
what: An independent nonprofit building mathematical foundations for the safety of powerful AI.

name: AI Safety Tokyo
what: A Tokyo community that runs AI safety study groups.

name: ALTER
what: An Israeli nonprofit for research and advocacy on the long-term future, including AI alignment research.
